Dimensions of the lot are (Approximately) 50 x 200 x 50 x 200
Nearest Cross Street: Roosevelt Avenue
The sale is subject to any unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water, and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
